title: Denomination
description: The ONE token the whole assembly's processes are denominated in — every bond (2×) and every payment moves in it. Any ERC-20; the clause names no token. A SPECIFIC term: the designer composes the token address into the template, tailoring the generic assembly — the pin is part of the assembly's identity (compositionHash), so the same composition in another token is a different assembly. Composed on the ROOT order (denomination is process-scoped; the kernel enforces one currency per process). An assembly without this clause is denominated by the BUYER'S PICK from the seller's accepted tokens at checkout, else the seller's default.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ERC-20 token address the assembly's processes bond and settle in.
